==30%==
Which digit occurs the most often when all the numbers from 1 to 1000 are listed?

From 1 to 1000 there are 192 zeros, while all the other digits except 1 occur 300 times each. The 1 occurs 301 times.

==25%==
If a flea likes to sleep on a leaf and a hornet likes to sit on a throne, a horse likes to gallop along a what?

The words are anagrams of each other, and ‘shore’ is an anagram of ‘horse’.

==20%==
If you were to fill a chessboard with the letters of the alphabet, starting back at A each time you got to Z, what letter would be in the 64th square?

The chessboard is irrelevant. This question is merely asking “What is the 12th letter of the alphabet?”. There are 26 letters in the alphabet. Once you have counted 52 letters you need to identify the 12th one which is L.

==15%==
If BZAAZFD is code for CABBAGE, what vegetable is STQMHO code for?

Each letter in the code is the one before the letter in the real word. so STQMHO is TURNIP.

==10%==
Logically, what should the last number on this credit card be?

1248 1632 6412 825'''6'''

It is a sequence of numbers where each one is doubled: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 etc, all the way to 128 which, when doubled, is 256.

== 5% ==
What three letters should replace the question marks under the KEY for it to be like the other pictures?
